# Site to Spend

> Google Ads management for small businesses.

Site to Spend's monthly Google Ads plan costs US$99/month for one business workspace. Check current signup availability on the [pricing page](https://sitetospend.com/pricing). The management fee covers keyword research, ad preparation, monitoring and reporting. Advertising spend is additional. The business approves its ads and budget before launch.

## Service and billing

- [Google Ads management](https://sitetospend.com/google-ads-management) explains who the service fits, which work is included and how to interpret a tracked enquiry.
- [How it works](https://sitetospend.com/how-it-works) follows the campaign from the business website to approval.
- [Features](https://sitetospend.com/features) describes keyword research, campaign preparation, monitoring and reporting.
- [Pricing](https://sitetospend.com/pricing) explains the monthly fee, prepaid ad credit and automatic top-ups.
- [Existing-account early-exit terms](https://sitetospend.com/terms-of-service#early-exit) explain the conditional setup fee for campaigns built in an account the customer owns. The clause exempts accounts Site to Spend provisions and operates.
- [Homepage](https://sitetospend.com/) includes the free ad preview and a [fictional campaign report](https://sitetospend.com/#sample-report) with ad spend and tracked enquiries.

## Practical Google Ads guides

- [Conversion tracking](https://sitetospend.com/blog/how-conversion-tracking-works) explains how to check that a successful enquiry is recorded.
- [Budget pacing](https://sitetospend.com/blog/how-budget-pacing-works) explains daily budgets and how to review spend.
- [Campaign structure](https://sitetospend.com/blog/google-ads-campaign-structure-mistakes) covers matching searches to ads and landing pages.
- [Campaign delivery](https://sitetospend.com/blog/why-your-google-ads-stop-working) covers billing, policy and other reasons ads may stop serving.
- [All guides](https://sitetospend.com/blog) and the [full text index](https://sitetospend.com/llms-full.txt).
